body.name: p_e
body.def: When \(d_e(G)<\infty\), \(p_e(t)\) is the unique monic minimal polynomial of \(\lambda_e\) over \(K_G\). A bounded rational-circuit representation in the covariance entries is output only under the valid-chart and successful-output conditions of \(\mathrm{thm:conditional\mbox{-}geometric\mbox{-}resolution}\).
